description: Corrected maintenance cost ordering. Key fix: full maintenance = warm tail-append (E26: 66ms), not cold re-prefill (E34 COLD: 3,620ms).
note_full_vs_E34: E34 Part C listed full COLD re-prefill 3,620ms as full maintenance cost. Corrected: full maintenance is warm tail-append (66ms, E26) because the KV cache prefix is preserved between consecutive turns. Cold re-prefill applies only on GPU eviction (not the normal maintenance path).
ordering_ascending_cost: sum200 restore (32 ms) — serves query from stale summary
full warm-append (66 ms, E26) — normal per-turn cost, voice budget
win10 amortized (653 ms) — blended grow+slide, interactive budget
sum200 recursive (~5822 ms) — generate new summary, background only
